description: IntentConfiguration with both confirmHandler and confirmationTokenConfirmHandler.

ios.result.error.message: You must provide either `confirmHandler` or `confirmationTokenConfirmHandler`, but not both

parityGaps.result.error.code: G5: iOS rejects an intentConfiguration with both handlers; Android accepts it and uses the confirmation-token handler (PaymentSheetManager.configureMode).
parityGaps.intentConfiguration.mode.amount: G5: See result.error.code; iOS builds no IntentConfiguration.

unasserted.params.intentConfiguration.mode.type: The builder consumes mode.type to choose payment or setup. Native code asserts the resulting mode, not this discriminator.
unasserted.params.intentConfiguration.mode.captureM: Both handlers are rejected before a configuration is built, so captureMethod is not observed.
